P10-Today-Plan.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 Today with the plan: the next batch with Start class; the groups by level with their material ready; one line per student (teach, then practise, check, homework); the brief · dark

P10-Today-Plan-Light.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 Today with the plan · light

P10-Today-Plan-Scrolled.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 Today scrolled: the smaller groups, the brief, then V1's sections (today's batches, coming up, tasks) and the Make something row

P10-Today-Planning.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 Planning today's class: the hero waits, the card names what is being made; a plan already made opens at once

P10-Today-Plan-StudentMenu.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 A student's line pressed: move to another group, skip the check or the homework today, leave the student out today

P10-Today-Plan-Changed.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 The plan changed by the tutor: Riya moved into Group 1 (the line says so), Nikhil's homework skipped today (struck through); the record learns, nothing is carried over

P10-Close.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 Start class, the close: the batch and day, the group's lines as a checklist, then each student: came (present by default), the three checks right or wrong, homework given; Done in the footer · dark

P10-Close-Scrolled.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 The close scrolled: Dev's checks tapped (2 of 3 right), Meher's untapped, Nikhil marked absent (his checks wait, a catch-up line joins the next plan)

P10-Close-Placement.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 In the close, a student with no checks yet gets the placement's questions in place of the three checks

P10-Today-AfterClose.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 Today after the close: what happened in the hero, what goes to parents now (each one read, then sent on WhatsApp) and what waits for the note day; tomorrow's batch below

P10-Today-NoteDay.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 The note day (Sunday evening): the notes waiting to be read and sent, one tap each; two sent; one held for consent; the week's next batch below

P10-Today-NoBatch.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 A day with no batch (Saturday): the next batch and when its plan is made; the day's event and the tasks as V1

P10-Today-Plan-Change.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.3 Change on the plan: how many groups, each group's subject today, keep it for this weekday (the weekly pattern), make the plan again

P10-Sheet.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 A sheet from the plan: who it is for, Paper | Board | Key, the questions; Share as PDF, Print, Make it again, Use my own · dark

P10-Sheet-Key.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 The sheet's key: each answer under its question, for the tutor; left out of the PDF unless chosen

P10-Sheet-Board.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 The board view: one question at a time in large type for the class to copy; Previous and Next, the count, Done; Key shows the answer under it

P10-Sheet-Regenerate.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Make it again: one tap and a reason (easier, harder, shorter, more sums, different numbers, or your own words)

P10-Sheet-Regenerating.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 The sheet being made again: the old one stays dimmed until the new one arrives (the Phase 6 pattern)

P10-Sheet-OwnMenu.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Use my own: the tutor's own sheet in place of the made one, by a photo, from Photos or typed

P10-Sheet-Own.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 The tutor's own sheet in the plan's place: the photo, when it was added, the same place in the record; the made sheet is kept behind a quiet action

P10-WorkedExample.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 The worked example, one step at a time: the problem, the steps shown so far, Show the next step; the slip to watch for under the button

P10-Figure-NumberLine.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Figure template: number line, drawn by the app from a typed spec with the tokens (D59); shown with the worked example and printed with the sheet

P10-Figure-FractionBar.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Figure template: fraction bar, drawn by the app from a typed spec with the tokens (D59); shown with the worked example and printed with the sheet

P10-Figure-PlaceValue.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Figure template: place value, drawn by the app from a typed spec with the tokens (D59); shown with the worked example and printed with the sheet

P10-Figure-UnitCircle.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Figure template: unit circle, drawn by the app from a typed spec with the tokens (D59); shown with the worked example and printed with the sheet

P10-Figure-Triangle.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Figure template: triangle, drawn by the app from a typed spec with the tokens (D59); shown with the worked example and printed with the sheet

P10-Figure-Cell.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Figure template: labelled cell, drawn by the app from a typed spec with the tokens (D59); shown with the worked example and printed with the sheet

P10-Figure-FoodChain.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 Figure template: food chain, drawn by the app from a typed spec with the tokens (D59); shown with the worked example and printed with the sheet

P10-Brief.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 The tutor's brief for a chapter above class 7 or one asked about: what it is about, three common mistakes, the worked example to use, words to say

P10-Mock.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 The mock two days before the school's test: in the school's pattern from its last papers (or the board's blueprint), the key, Mark from a photo (V1's Check a paper with this key)

P10-GapReport.dc.html.title: Phase 10 · 10.4 The gap report after a marked mock: the score, each skill with its bar and what went wrong, the last two days' lines, Use this plan

kit.text: Step 0.2 · Ember design system — the Kit (D20)

p2.text: Step 0.3 · Phase 2 boards — sign-in flow, onboarding, Today empty, Settings minimal, password (sign-in dark is board A in row 1)

p3.text: Step 0.4 · Phase 3 boards — students (list states, add menu, form, detail, confirmations) and classes

p4.text: Step 0.5 · Phase 4 boards — Today live, attendance (mark, saved, past date, the alert), history, More, schedule and events, tasks

p5.text: Step 0.6 · Phase 5 boards — fees (the month, due, paid, overdue, the payee), generate, mark paid, receipt, remind, waive, parent payments and the QR, a student's fees, reports and CSV, More and Settings live

p6.text: Step 0.7 · Phase 6 boards — AI Assistant (home, the four forms, the student picker, creating, results, create again, failure, the note on WhatsApp, history), scan register (intro, consent, the camera asks, the camera and Photos, reading, the list to check, fixing and removing a row, leaving, nothing found, failure, added), check a paper (intro, pages, the scheme, checking, the marks, changing one, saved, failure), More and Today's row

p7.text: Step 0.8 · Phase 7 boards — Settings in full (the profile saved as you go, parents, this iPhone, account, about), Account (methods, a password, sign out, delete account and what follows), Teacher reminders (not asked, the ask, on, all off, refused, the day), Help, More, offline (lists from the cache with their age, nothing saved, a write refused, attendance and a fee saved here), back online (sending, sent, a failure), pending changes, the notifications, the launch screen, the icon in place

p7b.text: Step 0.8b · Phase 7, from build 10 — New class from the student form; the account picture at the top right of Today; opening: the launch screen fading into Today; sign-in with Google's button by Google's guidelines

p8.text: Step 0.9 · Phase 8 boards — tutorcentral.in (home, privacy, terms, support, not found) at 1280 and 390, dark and light; U7 and U24

store.text: App Store screenshots · a caption over the real screen, dark, at 9:41, in the website's phone frame; exported at 1206 × 2622 (iPhone with Dynamic Island, medium), no transparency. Order is the store's order: the first three show in search

u33.text: U33 · Toasts the Apple way: the bottom bar stays only where it carries Undo (as Mail's Undo Send); everything else is native — in place, inline, or the system alert

p10_1.text: Step 10.1 · Phase 10, the shell — five tabs (Today, Students, School, Fees, More); More with Organise, Make and App; the School tab empty; Attendance under More; V1's class is a batch on screen

p10_2.text: Step 10.2 · Phase 10, Students — the list by tracking status; add student V2 (class, school, board from class 8, batch, the parent's language); the student's page with the record (skills and their states, the check trend, marks, homework, school items, messages, consent); consent asked and recorded; the textbook's contents page to chapters; the ladder for LKG to 3; the placement

p10_3.text: Step 10.3 · Phase 10, Today — the plan for the batch (level groups, the material ready, one line per student, the brief), planning, a line's menu and the plan changed, the Change sheet, the close (came, three checks, homework, Done; the placement inside it), after the close, the note day, a day with no batch

p10_4.text: Step 10.4 · Phase 10, the artefacts — the sheet in three forms (paper, board view, key), make it again with a reason, the tutor's own in its place, the worked example one step at a time, the seven figure templates drawn by the app (D59), the brief, the mock, the gap report
